title: US -- health-privacy basics
description: Plain-language obligations drawn from the US Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules, for organizations that handle protected health information.
disclaimer: Decision support only, not legal advice. Whether HIPAA applies, and how, depends on your organization's role; confirm with your privacy officer or counsel.

regulations.name: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules)
regulations.summary: US federal rules on the use, disclosure, and safeguarding of protected health information.

obligations.title: Use or disclose only the minimum necessary health information
obligations.text: Uses and disclosures of protected health information (PHI) must be limited to the minimum necessary to accomplish the intended purpose.

controls.title: Agents access only the PHI fields their task requires
controls.description: Automated steps are limited to the specific PHI fields needed, and requests for full records are refused.

obligations.title: Get written authorization for disclosures not otherwise permitted
obligations.text: Disclosing PHI for purposes other than treatment, payment, health care operations, or another permitted purpose requires the individual's written authorization.

controls.title: Disclosures outside permitted purposes are reviewed by the privacy officer
controls.description: Any automated disclosure of PHI to a third party for an unusual purpose stops for privacy officer review and checks that a valid authorization is on file.

obligations.title: Record and examine access to electronic PHI
obligations.text: Systems containing electronic PHI must have mechanisms that record and examine activity, so access can be audited.

controls.title: Log every agent access to PHI
controls.description: Every read or write of PHI by an automated step is logged with who or what accessed it, when, and why.

obligations.title: Have a business associate agreement before sharing PHI with a vendor
obligations.text: PHI may be shared with a vendor that performs functions on the organization's behalf only under a business associate agreement.

controls.title: Only send PHI to systems covered by a business associate agreement
controls.description: Automated steps send PHI only to applications recorded as covered by a business associate agreement.

obligations.title: Notify individuals of breaches of unsecured PHI within 60 days
obligations.text: Following discovery of a breach of unsecured PHI, affected individuals must be notified without unreasonable delay and no later than 60 calendar days after discovery.

controls.title: Escalate suspected PHI exposure to the privacy officer immediately
controls.description: Any automated step that detects a possible PHI exposure stops and escalates to the privacy officer.

glossary.definition: Protected health information: individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity or business associate.
Business associate agreement: the contract required before a vendor may handle PHI on an organization's behalf.
